name: scramble-on-hover
title: Scramble on Hover
description: Letters near the pointer scramble into other glyphs, like a magnet passing over iron filings, and settle back as it moves on. Unlike Decode, it reacts locally, where the cursor is.

meta.useWhen: A short label the visitor plays with (a name, a nav word, a project title) on a code, cipher or signal concept.
meta.avoidWhen: Words the visitor must read while pointing at them (buttons with actions); long text; for a one-time reveal (use Decode).
